summary: First Financial Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Finward Bancorp (seller) via stock-for-stock merger. Terms: each Finward share converts into 1.35 shares of First Financial common stock. The boards of both companies unanimously approved. Closing expected in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and Finward shareholder vote. Structure involves Finward merging into First Financial, with its bank subsidiary merging into First Financial Bank. Watch for regulatory timeline and shareholder approval risks; no premium percentage or break fee disclosed in filing.
